note: File Hash stores per-algorithm hashes as base fields/columns on the core file entity. All config is in filehash.settings (algorithms map of 18 booleans, dedupe 0/1/2, autohash, rehash, original, dedupe_original, mime_types, suppress_warnings). Enabling an algorithm fires a config onSave subscriber that adds a file_managed column; drush filehash:clean drops columns for disabled algorithms and filehash:generate backfills. Medium cases read back a live-enabled algorithm (sha256) and the autohash flag; hard cases enable sha256 (verified by config value AND the file_managed.sha256 column existing) and set global strict de-duplication. No permissions of its own; configure route filehash.admin.

evals.prompt: I just enabled the filehash module (and an algorithm) on a Drupal site that already has thousands of uploaded files. Which Drush command backfills hashes for those existing files, and does it have a short alias?
evals.expected_output: Run `drush filehash:generate` (aliases `fgen` / `filehash-generate`), which runs the Generate batch to compute and store hashes for existing files that don't have them yet.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the filehash module, where do I choose which hash algorithms (e.g. SHA-256) get computed for uploaded files, and what config object stores that choice?
evals.expected_output: On the File hash settings form at /admin/config/media/filehash (route filehash.admin), tick the algorithms you want. The choice is stored in the filehash.settings config object under the `algorithms` map (one boolean per algorithm). Saving it adds a matching column to the file_managed table.

evals.prompt: With the filehash module and SHA-256 enabled, how would I output a file's SHA-256 hash using Drupal's token system?
evals.expected_output: filehash exposes file tokens per enabled algorithm: use [file:filehash-sha256] for the full hash, and [file:filehash-sha256-pair-1] / [file:filehash-sha256-pair-2] for the first/second two-character pairs.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which file-hash algorithm is currently enabled in the filehash configuration? Inspect the live config and name it.
evals.expected_output: SHA-256 (algorithms.sha256 is true in filehash.settings); a matching file_managed.sha256 column exists. Check with `drush config:get filehash.settings algorithms`.

evals.prompt: Is this site's filehash module configured to automatically generate any missing file hashes when files are loaded? Inspect the live configuration and state the setting's value.
evals.expected_output: Yes: filehash.settings:autohash is true on the live site (drush config:get filehash.settings autohash), so missing hashes are generated on entity load.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the filehash module so that the SHA-256 hash algorithm is enabled and uploaded files will get a SHA-256 hash. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable algorithms.sha256 in filehash.settings (tick SHA-256 at /admin/config/media/filehash, or set the config value and save through the config API). Saving via the config API fires FileHashConfigSubscriber which adds the file_managed.sha256 column. Verified when the config value is true AND the sha256 column exists.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the filehash module to disallow duplicate file uploads site-wide at the strictest level (also checking against temporary files). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the global 'Disallow duplicate files' option to Strict, i.e. filehash.settings:dedupe = 2 (drush config:set filehash.settings dedupe 2 -y, or the 'Strict' radio at /admin/config/media/filehash). Verified when the live dedupe value is 2.
